decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate that the three trees, on the adjoining property at 22 Stile Hall Gardens, and their associated root systems will not be adversely impacted upon by the proposed building. Damage to the health or the loss of these trees would adversely impact on the character of the Wellesley Road Conservation Area and accordingly the proposal is not in accordance with policies ENV-B.2.2 and ENV- N.2.7 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - It has not been demonstrated that adequate visibility splays of 2.4m x 2.4m can be provided on each side of the access to the site, as such the proposed development would be prejudicial to the safety of the adjacent highway, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and T.4.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Proposed demolition of existing single storey detached garage and erection of replacement single storey detached garage.
